text_block_list.text:
The day of the Make Debut had finally arrived.
As we headed toward the racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —City-san, look over here please!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Could you give us a few words
ahead of your Make Debut!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Cityyy!!
Do your beeeest!!
The airport had turned into a bit of a scene, packed with reporters and fans waiting for her...
choice_data_list: Excuse me, but you're causing a nuisance to those around you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so cold, please!
Everyone's eager to know what top model Gold City is up to!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: There are fans who've been looking forward to this, you know! Even if it's just your thoughts heading into the race—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then please, make sure to write down
what I'm about to say.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Watch "me" as I run. Keep your eyes on me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll show you that I'm not just an Umamusume who's all about looks.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah~~~~!!
So cooooool~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
R-Really cool...
That photo and quote alone could make the front page!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, a beauty looks so intimidating when she gets fierce!
I've gotta make sure to capture her running face perfectly too!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I know people only look at my looks for now.
That's what I've been banking on, so it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't let them keep talking like that forever.
I have to produce results, and soon...!
choice_data_list: Try not to get too tense, okay?
Try not to get too tense, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't give it your all here,
where else are you gonna do it?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll run so fast they won't even have time to see my face—I'm gonna blow them away...!
choice_data_list: Go out there and run your own race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
'Like me'? What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Well, duh.
I run so that I can stay true to who I am."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Gold City is an Umamusume who runs in races.
First, we'll make them realize that with today's run!
